evals.prompt: samples/sample.xlsx 열어서 매출 시트에 '이익률' 열을 추가해줘. 합계의 30%로 계산하고 소수 첫째 자리까지 보이게. 나도 화면에서 보고 싶어.
evals.expected_output: Server started (or reused) and the preview URL given to the user; G1 header and G2:G7 formulas =E2*0.3..=E7*0.3 with number format showing one decimal; file not saved unless asked.
expectations: Ran xl.py serve and told the user the localhost URL to open in the preview pane
Used describe or read before editing
Wrote formulas with fill (relative references), not hard-coded numbers
Applied a number format with one decimal (nf like #,##0.0 or 0.0)
Did not run xl.py save because the user did not ask to save

evals.prompt: 내가 지금 미리보기에서 선택한 부분을 굵게 하고 노란색 배경으로 바꿔줘.
evals.expected_output: Agent queries xl.py selection, then formats exactly that range (b=true, bg yellow).
expectations: Called xl.py selection to find the user's current range
Formatted only that range with b=true and a yellow bg
Reported the batch id or how to undo

evals.prompt: sample.xlsx 매출 시트 3월 아래에 빈 행 하나 넣고, 데이터를 제품A 기준 내림차순으로 정렬한 다음 저장해줘.
evals.expected_output: rows insert 5, sort of the data range by B descending with the header kept, then save with backup; totals formulas still correct.
expectations: Used xl.py rows insert (not manual cell moves)
Used xl.py sort with --by B:desc (header row excluded)
Ran xl.py save and mentioned the backup
Verified totals with read after the changes

evals.prompt: 방금 내가 화면에서 몇 군데 고쳤는데, 뭘 바꿨는지 정리해줘.
evals.expected_output: Agent runs xl.py changes --actor user and summarizes the user's edits by range.
expectations: Summarized ranges and values without modifying the workbook
